item.title: Glamor Shines Bright Luncheon - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 18, 2026 - The Glamor Shines Bright Luncheon brought guests together for a stylish afternoon in support of PATCHES, a local charity dedicated to medically challenged children. The event featured a ladies luncheon and fashion show, where attendees enjoyed a blend of philanthropy and fashion while raising awareness and funds for an impactful cause.

item.title: JW Marriott Marquis Miami & JW Marriott Miami Present: Match Point Passion Party - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 18, 2026 - JW Marriott Marquis Miami and the JW Marriott Miami brought back their famous Match Point Passion Party this week in celebration of the Miami Open. The evening brought some of the best tennis players in the world together for a night of music and fun at the 19th floor tennis court of the JW Marriott Marquis Miami.

item.title: Amura x Bea Interiors Showroom Opening - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 18, 2026 - Bea Interiors Design hosted a special showroom event in collaboration with Amura, bringing together designers, collectors, and friends of the studio for an evening celebrating contemporary design and craftsmanship. Guests explored curated furniture pieces while enjoying cocktails and a live DJ set, creating an intimate gathering that blended creativity with a social atmosphere.

item.title: WRE News: Real Housewives of Miami Hits Pause as Bravo Eyes Major Reboot - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 19, 2026 - Production on The Real Housewives of Miami has been halted for now, with no confirmed plans for a new season, according to sources close to the series. While the show hasn’t been formally canceled, Bravo is reportedly reassessing the franchise’s direction, exploring everything from a cast shakeup to a full-scale reboot. item.title: Kris R at LIV - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 19, 2026 - Kris R took over LIV for a late-night set that kept the crowd moving from start to finish. The Colombian artist brought his signature Latin sound to the packed club, delivering a high-energy performance that carried the party well into the early hours.

item.title: Shaggy at E11EVEN - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 20, 2026 - Shaggy took over E11EVEN for a high-energy night as the Grammy-winning artist delivered a set packed with his biggest hits. The crowd sang along as the dancehall icon kept the party going well into the early hours inside the 24-hour hotspot.

item.title: The GFL Padel Series Pro-Am In Memory of Sean Posner - Benefiting the Miami Beach JCC & Sean Posner Padel Academy at Sunset Padel - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - March 22, 2026 - Chris Paciello, Rafi Gibly, and the entire Sunset team along with Jarrett Posner, Wayne Boich, Adam Arviv, Patrick Dovigi, Mark Groussman and Raleigh Smith hosted a fundraiser Pro Am tournament at Sunset Padel benefiting the Miami Beach JCC in support of the Sean Posner Padel Academy, in memory of the beloved Sean Posner - A Jordan Moreira Davidson initiative.
